_note: C2: a reasonable opinion essay that never uses the sources. Expect low evidence and source ratings.
assignment_text: Using the sources, argue whether your town should limit cars downtown.

source_passages.title: A Car-Free Downtown
source_passages.text: Several European cities closed their centers to cars; air quality improved and foot traffic to shops rose.

source_passages.title: The Cost of Going Car-Free
source_passages.text: Critics note delivery businesses and people with disabilities can be harmed when car access is removed without alternatives.

essay_text: I think cars should be banned downtown because walking is healthier and it is nicer without traffic. Everyone I know agrees. Cars are loud and annoying, so the town should just get rid of them.
